description:
For generations, homes were built to heat, cool, and power
themselves — no HVAC, no utility company, no monthly bill.
Then cheap energy arrived, and we quietly forgot how.

This channel brings those methods back.

📄 How to Cut Your Energy Bills Toward Zero:
passivehousefiles.com

The earth loops. The ground tunnels. The sun on your roof.
The water past your land. These aren't lost secrets — they're
documented, proven building methods, still working today, and
almost nobody builds with them anymore.

The Passive House Files is a record of
those methods — heating, cooling, and off-grid power — explained
step by step, with real numbers and honest results, for any home
you already own.

No miracle gadgets. No hype. No "free energy" scams. Just the
real, low-tech ways to make a home stand on its own.

New build. Every video.

Subscribe if you want to understand what the energy industry
stopped showing you how to do.
